PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED:

2010-05-18 | 161 m MD | Namsang | cementing_issue | medium | 2.9 hrs NPT
Cause: Poor cement bond / losses during primary cementing of casing shoe in Namsang.
Remedy: Squeeze cemented shoe track, pressure tested to spec before drilling out.

2010-05-18 | 223 m MD | Namsang | wellbore_instability | medium | 4.2 hrs NPT
Cause: Wellbore washout suspected in Namsang, oversized cuttings at surface.
Remedy: Adjusted mud rheology, ran wiper trips before continuing.

2010-05-18 | 422 m MD | Namsang | wellbore_instability | medium | 3.9 hrs NPT
Cause: Hole instability / cavings on surface while drilling Namsang, tight hole on connections.
Remedy: Increased mud weight and viscosity, short-tripped to condition hole.

2010-05-19 | 810 m MD | Girujan | stuck_pipe | high | 6.1 hrs NPT
Cause: Differential sticking in Girujan, no rotation or reciprocation possible.
Remedy: Reduced mud weight, spotted spotting fluid across pay zone, freed string on jarring.

2010-05-19 | 824 m MD | Girujan | fishing_operation | high | 11.5 hrs NPT
Cause: Following stuck pipe in Girujan, back-off performed, fish left in hole.
Remedy: Ran fishing BHA, latched fish with overshot, recovered string to surface.

2010-05-20 | 1227 m MD | Girujan | wellbore_instability | low | 4.4 hrs NPT
Cause: Hole instability / cavings on surface while drilling Girujan, tight hole on connections.
Remedy: Increased mud weight and viscosity, short-tripped to condition hole.

2010-05-20 | 1264 m MD | Tipam | cementing_issue | medium | 4.2 hrs NPT
Cause: Poor cement bond / losses during primary cementing of casing shoe in Tipam.
Remedy: Squeeze cemented shoe track, pressure tested to spec before drilling out.

2010-05-20 | 1323 m MD | Tipam | mud_loss | medium | 5.9 hrs NPT
Cause: Lost circulation 49 bbl/hr while drilling Tipam sand, partial returns only.
Remedy: Pumped 85 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.

2010-05-22 | 2093 m MD | Barail | overpressure | high | 7.2 hrs NPT
Cause: SPP trend increasing and drag rising while drilling into Barail, suspected transition zone.
Remedy: Raised mud weight in 97-ppg steps, monitored trip gas, continued drilling with caution.

2010-05-24 | 2702 m MD | Sylhet | mud_loss | high | 7.5 hrs NPT
Cause: Total losses encountered in Sylhet, no returns to surface for 7.5 hrs.
Remedy: Pumped cement plug to seal loss zone, waited on cement, tested integrity before resuming.

2010-05-24 | 2721 m MD | Sylhet | mud_loss | low | 1.4 hrs NPT
Cause: Total losses encountered in Sylhet, no returns to surface for 1.4 hrs.
